_meta._docs: These are MARIN'S coaching principles. They are fed into MILO's program-builder prompt so generated programs sound like Marin wrote them. Edit on /principles.html, or directly in this JSON.

philosophy: What I believe matters most in training. Speak in 2-3 sentences as if explaining your approach to a new coach. e.g.: 'I coach for longevity and capability. Strength is built on movement quality. Volume is earned, not assumed.'
session_structure: How I structure every session. e.g.: Every session opens with Mobility Prep (3-5 min, low-key). Then 1 primary compound pattern (Hinge, Squat, Push, or Pull) at the heaviest. Accessory work paired with the primary. Carry or core finisher closes most sessions.

mobility_pools._docs: Exercise pools per mobility category. Used to fill in any mobility block in a template (templates specify WHEN, this specifies WHAT). MILO picks an exercise from the relevant pool, varying across sessions to keep it fresh.

session_balance_rules._docs: Rules MILO must follow across all template-driven program generations. They preserve movement balance + mobility coverage across each week.
session_balance_rules.push_pull_alternation: Across a 2-session week (A/B): Day A push & pull = HORIZONTAL. Day B push & pull = VERTICAL. Across 3-session week: rotate horizontal → vertical → horizontal-unilateral. Mix patterns so no single shoulder position is over-trained.
session_balance_rules.mobility_woven_in_session: Mobility is NOT just prepended to the session. Templates specify mobility blocks at meaningful points: typically after the first strength superset pair (mid-session reset) and after conditioning (cool-down). Different sessions cover different categories so the week (A+B+...) covers ankle + hip + t-spine.
session_balance_rules.default_mobility_distribution_a_b: Workout A: hip mobility after 1a/1b strength pair, ankle mobility after conditioning. Workout B: t-spine mobility after 1a/1b strength pair, ankle mobility after conditioning. Across the week: hip + t-spine + 2×ankle.
session_balance_rules.mobility_block_duration: 1-2 minutes per mobility block (flow / quality reps, not a heavy stretch session)

weekly_template: How I think about week structure. e.g.: 3 strength sessions/week is the default for most H&P clients. Avoid heavy hinge + heavy squat consecutive days. Frontal/transverse plane work at least 1x/week.

preferred_exercises._docs: Your go-to exercises for each pattern. MILO will prefer these when generating programs.

exercises_to_avoid._docs: Exercises I avoid prescribing (for any reason - safety, philosophy, equipment).
list: Conventional deadlift for clients with low-back history

progression_model: How loads/volume should change from week to week. e.g.: Linear within block — week 1 introduce, week 2 build, week 3 peak, week 4 deload. Primary lifts: add load when RPE drops by 1. Accessories: add reps before load.

rpe_targets_by_phase.peak_week: Working sets RPE 8-9 for 1-2 top sets
rpe_targets_by_phase.deload_week: Working sets RPE 4-5, half the volume

rules_i_follow: Always include Mobility Prep at the start
Pair antagonist patterns where possible (push + pull, hinge + anti-extension core)
Frontal/transverse plane at least 1 exercise per week
Compound multi-pattern sessions, NOT bodybuilder splits
things_to_never_do: Program more than 4 sessions/week for executive clients (recovery debt)
Two heavy bilateral lower sessions in a row
session_naming_style: How I name my sessions. Look at recent workouts to see the pattern - usually 'PrimaryPattern + Secondary + Finisher' (e.g. 'Hinge, Carry, Core' or 'Push, Glute, Hip')
current_focus: Anything I'm specifically focused on across the squad right now. Free text — e.g. 'Winter prep — building base strength. Reducing volume slightly to push more recovery quality.'
